name: OpenClaw (Hari)
description: Personal OpenClaw instance for Hari. OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant that can be controlled from messaging platforms like Matrix. This instance is fully isolated from any other OpenClaw deployment in this app store.
author: openclaw

form_fields.label: Gateway auth token
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated. Required for non-loopback access. Use this token to authenticate API/WebSocket clients.

form_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
form_fields.hint: Required if using OpenAI-compatible providers via OPENAI_BASE_URL. For OpenRouter, you can use this field with the OpenRouter base URL below, or use the dedicated OpenRouter key field instead.

form_fields.label: OpenAI Base URL
form_fields.hint: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave blank for OpenAI direct. For OpenRouter via the OpenAI-compat shim, set to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 (but prefer the dedicated OpenRouter API Key field below — it uses Hermes/OpenClaw's native OpenRouter provider).

form_fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
form_fields.hint: Native OpenRouter provider key. Use this OR OPENAI_API_KEY+BASE_URL — not both.

form_fields.label: Anthropic API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. For direct Anthropic Claude access (not via OpenRouter).

form_fields.label: Slack bot token
form_fields.hint: Slack bot OAuth token (xoxb-...). Optional. Slack is a bundled channel in OpenClaw — setting this enables it.

form_fields.label: Slack app token
form_fields.hint: Slack app-level token (xapp-...) for socket mode. Required alongside the bot token if the Slack app uses socket-mode events instead of HTTP webhooks.
